entities.summary: The Church of Saint-Étienne is a Roman Catholic church located on the Rue de l'Hôpital Militaire in Lille, France. It has been classed as a monument historique since 1987 and is dedicated to Saint Stephen. It is one of the largest Jesuit churches in France.
